answer: Each agent stakes a bond whose cipher derives from one continuous voyage of work history. A sybil farm gains parallel identities but multiplies stake at risk; honest agents amortize a single bond across all earnings. The prism — a verifier splitting behavior streams into distinct signals — exposes identical timing and output fingerprints shared across fakes. Attack profit collapses below bond forfeiture cost, so rational play is one reputable identity. Equilibrium: sybils exit, reputation accrues to scarce proven agents.
